## Exact scope and independence

Formal M4 assessment covers the frozen working-tree engineering diff against d3396a22, not a hypothetical future commit. All nineteen registered implementation-m4 subjects match current bytes. Design r6's thirteen exact members and Delivery r3's unchanged plan match current identities. Parent authored implementation, documentation and tests; separate distribution-code-reviewer authored none and made no source/route/work mutations. This new milestone judgment follows current complete M4 inspection, not merely earlier preparation messages. Additional broad smoke is final verification evidence, not silently treated as completed M4 proof.

## Checklist

1. Spec alignment: pass. Exactly the five approved specification/test-spec pairs and five ADRs are deleted. Mixed architecture relinquishes only Distribution's selected container/runtime/deployment and decision/navigation responsibilities; conditional governance, owner links and FU-013 receiving change match the source map. FU-013 remains open pending successful Verify, and installation does not adopt customers. No unselected source deletion is inferred from references.
2. Test coverage: pass. C7/C8 check actual reader and selector behavior as well as documents. Current route sentence is exercised through portability evaluation and real generated archives. Added deletion-selection tests cover worktree/committed deletion, present/unproven/dangling input and plan-index composition. Actual candidate integration overlays current canonical skills, scripts, installer and templates before real generation, packing and install. Required metadata/tree/count and resource negative tests remain.
3. Edge cases: pass. Lifecycle deletion suppression applies only to changed, genuinely absent lifecycle artifacts with tracked/history proof, after all path contributors. Present files, dangling symlinks and unproven missing paths retain validation or block. Non-lifecycle historical workflow guidance remains selected; PR mode retains its unconditional revision-bound lifecycle check. No global missing-file bypass is introduced.
4. Error handling: pass. Intermediate failing C3/C8 runs are recorded as failures, and actual consumer corrections are followed by full green checks. Exact route matcher still rejects malformed shared arguments/identities and suspicious text. Each retained mutation must actually change source, avoiding vacuous negative evidence. Source removal is not used to suppress malformed current recording stores.
5. Architecture boundaries: pass. Design r6 independently approves the amended ownership/navigation package; this Code Review assesses actual implementation of that source map. Distribution retains generation/install, Skill content/resources, Release publication/evidence and Workflow/CLI recording coordination/mechanics. The selector change reuses existing provenance and classification helpers rather than adding an execution model or gate.
6. Compatibility: pass within approved withdrawal. The six removed route mutations exclusively target the retired OpenCode clause; generic obfuscated/additional text and supported-target checks remain. Historical v0.5.1 bundle/index bytes are preserved; fresh current archives need new identities rather than forced equality with historical hashes. Current metadata proof independently checks ZIP hash/size/root count/inventory, while actual candidate integration proves the fresh packed trust chain. No historical package is backfilled as two-target.
7. Security/privacy: pass. No new external authority, secret output or installer state behavior. Deleted-source selection requires existing Git proof and current absence; it cannot turn a present or symlinked artifact into an ignored input. Source-map/navigation edits do not weaken package integrity, path containment or runtime preservation established by unchanged M1–M3 implementation.
8. Derived artifact currency: pass within M4. Canonical route text and exact Python portability matcher agree on Codex/Claude, preventing route omission from Claude packages. Real full archive/candidate/packed checks ran against current source rather than a stale clone. Installed local skills remain unmodified. Historical records remain historical and are not regenerated.
9. Unrelated changes: pass. Additional runtime code edits are necessary consumers of the selected source/target withdrawal: route portability recognition and lifecycle deletion selection. Fixture changes restore actual current producer inputs. No unrelated refactor or new validator/cache/catalog capability. Current operational navigation is distinguished from historical IDs and unrelated retained source remainders.
10. Validation evidence: pass. Registered implementation-m4 contains full exact deletion identities, historical population, actual commands/results and E1/E2/E3 continuation. Original M3 C3 passed before six exclusive mutation retirements; current replacement route/resource proofs and actual candidate integration passed afterward. Existing validation owners and measured command population remain; final changed-line and measured-source evidence disclose one-run host/population limits. Required C3/C7/C8/C9/C10 checks are complete. Broader legacy prose debt is explicitly not claimed as full-file success.

## Independent evidence and author-proof reliance

Reviewer directly compared every one of the150 historical audit paths against d3396a22: no byte changes. Independently extracted the architecture's exact complete Follow-on artifacts section up to its next level-two heading: identical11616 characters. A whole-file suffix comparison would include the separately amended Readiness section and is not the claimed Follow-on scope. Actual deletion list is exactly15 approved files. Prior model renewal inspected the removal map and all changed owner/navigation sections, with scoped legacy classification; this review confirms their actual unchanged registered bytes.

Reviewer ran two route portability/negative tests:2 passed2.719s. Reviewer ran final selector PR-contained-surface and plan-index-deletion tests:2 passed0.14s, after earlier three provenance/composition tests passed0.21s. The final narrowing changes only lifecycle-category applicability; earlier present/dangling/unproven proof remains valid. All reviewer fixture runs used isolated test repositories and no source edits.

Author full C3 passed154 in467.791s; full selector passed160 in62.93s; actual current candidate/packed metadata chain passed1 in87.016s. Final C8 explicit all-path selection exited0 with every selected check passing in408.559s, including actual release/packed/CLI/selector/record/document readers. C7 boundary90/lifecycle112 passed; C9/C10 passed with their declared scope. Legacy audit308errors/115warnings is unchanged existing debt (275architecture/new-change plus33retained-spec errors), not a full legacy prose pass. Exact model/plan enforcement reports0. Added broad smoke is not claimed here as success and does not replace final Verify.

The six retained specs' format classification remains the independently recorded r6 distinction: five grandfathered, published-skill-first retaining its existing boundary/proof obligations. No blanket waiver or premature adoption follows from C9 observations. No published-skill behavioral scope changed beyond removing the unsupported OpenCode invocation example; route's description, triggers, owner, procedure, stop conditions, argument forms and handoff remain coherent for both supported targets, and transformed actual package proof confirms retained delivery.

## Handoff

M4 has no required finding. Route may close M4 and request the mandatory distinct fresh independent whole-change Code Review of the complete base-to-final implementation and interactions. This milestone review is not that final assessment. Distinct Verify and its final explanation/adoption judgment remain after final review; no branch, PR, publication or successful Verify readiness is claimed.
